name: core-doc-comments
brief: Correct six comments and XML doc blocks recorded in .sir/backlog.md as false or incomplete, in Domain, Application and App.Core, changing no executable code. D1 re-breaks /// lines that split sentences mid-clause in CanvasPoint, PlacedObject and ObjectKind (CORE-036, plus CanvasPoint:19 that its predicate missed). D2 scopes Result<T>.Value's 'only closed construction' claim to production code. D3 removes CanvasPoint's unreachable commit-time DbUpdateException description while keeping the ADO-provider attribution. D4 qualifies Area's once-only Outline-wrapper claim, which ??= does not guarantee under concurrent first reads. D6 documents Translate's ArgumentOutOfRangeException. D5 was re-measured as already fixed and is closed with evidence. An optional task closes MASTER-180 in the audit register and corrects CORE-036. Every edit keeps CRLF, words outside rewritten paragraphs, and non-comment lines byte-identical, proven by the instruments in contracts/C1-measurement.md.
